name: Beef and Broccoli
desc: Tender flank steak and crisp broccoli in a sweet soy-ginger sauce

ingredients.raw: Sauce: 1 tsp grated ginger, 2 tsp garlic, 1/2 cup hot water, 6 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 1/2 tbsp cornstarch, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp sesame oil

steps: Start white rice. Combine all sauce ingredients and stir to dissolve sugar.
Saute broccoli in 1 tbsp oil 4-5 min, partially covered, until crisp-tender. Remove.
Increase to high heat. Cook steak in single layer 2 min per side.
Add sauce, reduce heat, simmer 3-4 min until thickened.
Add broccoli back, toss. Serve over rice.
